notes.title: Update — English translation improvements and other fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34024430/ce7d5b937cedd97b274abcc7cb7939058a92b772.png[/img]

[b]We are glad to inform you that we've improved the overall game experience based on the community feedback:[/b]

[list]
[*] "Sanator: Chronicles of Reustadt" is now included in the base game (+ one new achievement). 
[*] Improved the English translation with the help of an English native editor. 
[*] Improved the language selection screen.
[*] Fixed the reported bugs and typos.
[/list]
